name: audit_query
title: Search Audit Events
description: Reads the caller tenant audit trail with filters. Read-only introspection over the platform audit chain. Note: tool executions are recorded under action "tool.execute" with the tool name in payload.tool — filter by action "tool.execute", not by tool name.

action.description: Filter by action name (e.g. "tool.execute" for tool calls; the tool name itself lives in payload.tool).

offset.description: Number of events to skip for pagination.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

total.description: Total available; may exceed returned entries.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
